result:
`validateApp` now throws if `owner` is missing or empty. Billing, reports and core-shell each pass their owning team. I merged PR #1, CI and CD both came back green, and I ran `st done`.

- **Owners:** billing passes `payments`, reports passes `insights`, and core-shell passes `platform`. Each comes from the `team` field in that app's `package.json`. Core-shell wasn't in the ticket, but it also calls `validateApp` and would have failed at startup without an owner.
- **One PR instead of three:** `shared-contracts` lives in the monorepo and is inlined into each app at build time (per CONTRIBUTING.md). There is no registry release or dependency update, so I did all three sub-tasks together. I built all three apps locally before pushing.
- **Reports isn't deployed:** the CD pipeline only deploys core-shell and billing. The reports change merged and passed CI, but I can't tell you it went live, because CD has no deploy path for reports.
- **Possibly not really live:** the CD docs say deploys are switched off by default (`DEPLOY_ENABLED`) and AWS isn't provisioned. CD reported SUCCESS, but I didn't check whether it actually published anything.

PR: #1 (`plat-103-require-owner`).
